name: Tompa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Tompa: a crowned red shield with a blue bend, a white bird and a bunch of grapes, with red and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed TOMPA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tompa arms with crown, mantling and scroll
